## Description

After publishing a USE release, update the project to the next development
version. Change the following files:

* ./pom.xml
* ./use-assembly/pom.xml
* ./use-core/pom.xml
* ./use-core/src/main/java/org/tzi/use/config/Options.java
* ./use-gui/pom.xml
